Use this form to report a technical error, a crash or unexpected screen behavior that is blocking your work. Reports from this form go straight to the UiPath engineering team.
This form is anonymous, so we won't reply individually, but we'll do our best to fix it as soon as we can.

This choice is effective for up to 30 days, after which the newest version is restored automatically. You can always return to this screen and choose a different version or the latest one.
